S K Y ’ S T H E L I M I T
The racing heritage of Maserati becomes an even more direct,
hands-on experience inside the GranCabrio MC. And with the
roof down, it feels like the sky’s the limit. The wraparound Sport
seats echo the elegant lines of the exterior, while providing the
extra hold needed for spirited driving. The headrests integrated
into the seatbacks are embossed with the Maserati logo. The
revised three-spoke Sport steering wheel has a more heavily
profiled grip, while the top and bottom of the rim are flattened
to ensure even greater focus and precision. Behind it, there are
longer Trofeo Design gearshift paddles, available in carbon fibre
on request. The accelerator and brake pedals, meanwhile, are in
perforated aluminium as standard – a detail taken straight from
the race track for optimum lightness and grip.
